rule: A link is not a download. Train only when the license on the card allows it. Keep a hidden test you do not train on.

datasets.name: Common Corpus
datasets.license: Public domain and open licenses, named on each document
datasets.note: About 2.27 trillion tokens. Best fit when every source must be free to use.

datasets.name: FineWeb
datasets.note: Large English web set. Attribute it. Start with a sample, not the full download.

datasets.name: FineWeb-Edu
datasets.note: Educational slice of FineWeb. Smaller and stronger per token than raw web text.

datasets.name: FineWeb 2
datasets.note: Multilingual web text. Same attribution rule as FineWeb.

datasets.name: Dolma
datasets.license: ODC-By, plus each source's own terms
datasets.note: About 3 trillion tokens. Web, code, papers, and books. Upstream terms still apply.

datasets.name: C4
datasets.note: Older cleaned web crawl. FineWeb is the newer set of this kind.

datasets.name: Wikipedia
datasets.note: Share-alike. A model card should say Wikipedia was a source.

datasets.name: OpenWebMath
datasets.note: Math pages from the web. Use it for math practice, not as the whole model.

datasets.name: FineMath
datasets.note: Filtered math text. Confirm the card before a commercial run.

datasets.name: Dolly 15k
datasets.note: 15,000 instructions written by people. Small. Good for a first fine-tune.

datasets.name: RedPajama v2
datasets.note: Huge, with quality tags. Read the crawl terms before training.

datasets.name: DCLM baseline
datasets.note: Quality-filtered web text used in the DataComp language bake-off.

datasets.name: The Stack v2
datasets.license: Each code file keeps its own license
datasets.note: Do not train on the whole set. Keep only files whose license allows training.

datasets.name: StarCoder data
datasets.note: Code that was already filtered toward permissive licenses. Confirm before training.

datasets.name: UltraChat 200k
datasets.note: Chat transcripts for a fine-tune. The card, not this page, is the license.

datasets.name: Tulu 3 mix
datasets.note: Instruction mix from Allen AI. Check the card before a customer trains on it.

datasets.name: SmolLM corpus
datasets.note: A smaller pretraining mix used for SmolLM. Practical when the big sets do not fit.

datasets.name: FinePDFs
datasets.note: Text taken from PDFs. Confirm the license before training.

datasets.name: TxT360
datasets.note: A documented pretraining mix. The card lists what is inside.

datasets.name: CulturaX
datasets.note: Multilingual web text. Read the license before a commercial train.

datasets.name: Community OSCAR
datasets.note: Multilingual crawl. OSCAR has its own terms.

datasets.name: GSM8K
datasets.note: This is a test, not a training set. Training on it makes the score meaningless.
